fixture_notice: All organizations, repositories, issue keys, and scenarios are fictional.

cases.query: Review GitHub pull request 42 in octo-org/parcel-api against the linked NORTH-218 acceptance criteria. Keep the provider read-only.
cases.reason: A remote PR and requirement-coverage review are the primary workflow.

cases.query: Can you review GitLab MR !73? Pin the head SHA, inspect surrounding authorization code, and tell me only concrete defects.
cases.reason: This is a GitLab change review with immutable revision evidence.

cases.query: Review my unstaged local diff for regressions and missing tests; don't edit anything yet.
cases.reason: The Skill explicitly supports read-only local diff review.

cases.query: Compare everything changed since tag v2.4.0 with HEAD and review the behavioral impact before I open a PR.
cases.reason: A fixed-point-to-HEAD review is supported even without a remote PR.

cases.query: Take a hard look at the tenant authorization changes in this PR. Trace callers and error paths, not just the patch.
cases.reason: The request needs surrounding-code review of a change set.

cases.query: The remote diff is truncated. Review what can be verified and clearly list what remains uncovered.
cases.reason: Partial-provider evidence is an explicit degraded review case.

cases.query: 审查这个 GitHub PR，并逐条核对 Jira 验收标准；不要评论、批准或修改代码。
cases.reason: The Chinese request explicitly asks for read-only PR and acceptance review.

cases.query: 帮我看看当前分支相对 main 的补丁有没有并发问题，测试是否覆盖了所有行为。
cases.reason: This asks for a local branch-diff correctness review.

cases.query: pls sanity-check MR 19 before merge—focus on real blockers and cite file/line evidence
cases.reason: Casual wording still clearly requests a merge-request review.

cases.query: Review these three commits as one change and separate implementation defects from missing requirement coverage.
cases.reason: The request matches the Skill's two-axis review model.

cases.query: The review is done. Stage the fixes, commit them, push the branch, and open a draft PR.
cases.reason: Mutation and delivery belong to git-change-delivery.

cases.query: Summarize a Jira issue, its comments, linked issues, and attachment metadata without reviewing code.
cases.reason: Issue retrieval without a change set is outside this review Skill.

cases.query: Scan package-lock.json and composer.lock for known vulnerable versions.
cases.reason: Dependency advisory analysis belongs to repository-vulnerabilities.

cases.query: Implement all requested changes from these review comments and run the tests.
cases.reason: The request is implementation, not read-only review.

cases.query: GitHub Actions is red on PR 42; debug the failing integration-test job and fix it.
cases.reason: CI failure diagnosis and implementation are distinct from a general PR review.

cases.query: This feature idea is still vague. Brainstorm the design and turn it into acceptance criteria.
cases.reason: Requirement discovery belongs to requirements-clarification.

cases.query: Which image digest is currently deployed in staging?
cases.reason: Runtime version lookup is outside change review.

cases.query: 不用审查，直接在 GitLab 上批准这个 MR。
cases.reason: A bare approval request is an external mutation, not a review workflow.

cases.query: Generate release notes from the commits merged since last Friday.
cases.reason: Release-note generation is not change review.

cases.query: 解释 src/router.ts 和 src/handler.ts 现在是怎么协作的，没有 PR 或变更范围。
cases.reason: General code explanation without a change target should not select PR/MR review.

cases.query: https://github.com/octo-org/parcel-api/pull/42
cases.reason: A standalone GitHub PR URL is an explicit remote target and should locate a matching checkout from the execution directory.

cases.query: 审查 /work/parcel-api 这个目录当前的修改。
cases.reason: A supplied directory selects a local review based on its Git status and local change set.
